name: Lan
description: Oval face with bright almond-shaped eyes and arched brows; shoulder-length straight black hair with a neat fringe; warm medium-tan skin; tall and slim build with good posture; default expression is a warm, knowing smile — the kind that says 'I told you so' affectionately
outfit: Mustard-yellow oversized shirt tucked into terracotta wide-leg trousers; simple white sneakers; small round tortoiseshell glasses perched on her nose — no logos or text
personality: Calm, older-sister energy — wise and gently teasing, never preachy
